name: American Football Trivia
description: Scoring, rules, Super Bowl history and the gridiron’s most famous plays.
question: {prompt}

cards.prompt: How many points is a touchdown worth?
cards.fact: The "seven points" people expect includes the extra-point kick that usually follows.

cards.prompt: How many points is a field goal worth?
cards.fact: A field goal must pass between the uprights and over the crossbar.

cards.prompt: How many points does the defense score for a safety?
cards.fact: After a safety, the team that gave it up must also kick the ball away.

cards.prompt: How many points is the kick after a touchdown worth?
cards.fact: Teams can instead try a two-point conversion by running or passing into the end zone.

cards.prompt: How many points is a successful conversion run or passed in after a touchdown?
cards.fact: The NFL adopted the two-point conversion in 1994; college football had it since 1958.

cards.prompt: How many downs does the offense get to gain a first down?
cards.fact: Teams usually punt on fourth down rather than risk handing over good field position.

cards.prompt: How many yards must the offense gain for a new first down?
cards.fact: The chain crew on the sideline measures exactly 10 yards.

cards.prompt: How many players does each team have on the field at once?
cards.fact: Having 12 on the field during a play is a penalty.

cards.prompt: How many yards is it from one goal line to the other?
cards.fact: Add two 10-yard end zones and the full field is 120 yards long.

cards.prompt: Which player usually snaps the ball to the quarterback?
cards.fact: Every play from scrimmage begins with a snap.

cards.prompt: Tackling the quarterback behind the line of scrimmage before he throws is called what?
cards.fact: Hall of Famer Deacon Jones is credited with coining the term.

cards.prompt: An interception returned for a touchdown is nicknamed what?
cards.fact: The "six" is the six points of the touchdown.

cards.prompt: A long, desperate pass into the end zone at the end of a half is nicknamed what?
cards.fact: Roger Staubach popularized the name after a winning playoff pass in 1975.

cards.prompt: A punt returner waving one arm overhead is signaling what?
cards.fact: After a fair catch, the returner can’t run with the ball, but defenders can’t hit him.

cards.prompt: An offensive lineman moving before the snap commits which penalty?
cards.fact: A false start costs the offense five yards.

cards.prompt: What color is the flag officials throw for a penalty in the NFL?
cards.fact: Coaches throw a red flag to challenge a call.

cards.prompt: Which team won Super Bowl I in January 1967?
cards.fact: The Packers beat the AFL’s Kansas City Chiefs 35–10.

cards.prompt: The Super Bowl trophy is named after which coach?
cards.fact: Lombardi’s Packers won the first two Super Bowls.

cards.prompt: Which quarterback famously guaranteed a New York Jets win in Super Bowl III?
cards.fact: The Jets’ upset of the Baltimore Colts proved the AFL could compete with the NFL.

cards.prompt: Which team went 17–0 in 1972 for a perfect season capped by a Super Bowl win?
cards.fact: The 2007 Patriots went 18–0 before losing the Super Bowl to the Giants.

cards.prompt: How many Super Bowls did Tom Brady win as a player?
cards.fact: Brady won six with the New England Patriots and one with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

cards.prompt: Which Super Bowl dropped Roman numerals and used regular numbers instead?
cards.fact: Organizers reportedly thought a lone "L" made a poor logo; Roman numerals returned with LI.

cards.prompt: Which Steelers running back made the "Immaculate Reception" in 1972?
cards.fact: The deflected pass gave Pittsburgh its first-ever playoff win.

cards.prompt: Who caught Joe Montana’s pass for "The Catch" in the January 1982 NFC Championship Game?
cards.fact: The leaping grab beat the Dallas Cowboys and sent the 49ers to their first Super Bowl.

cards.prompt: Who holds the NFL career records for receptions and receiving yards?
cards.fact: Rice finished with 22,895 receiving yards — more than 5,000 ahead of the next player.

cards.prompt: Who holds the NFL career rushing yards record?
cards.fact: Smith passed Walter Payton in 2002 and finished with 18,355 yards.

cards.prompt: Which Chicago Bears running back was nicknamed "Sweetness"?
cards.fact: The NFL’s Man of the Year award is named after Payton.

cards.prompt: Which trophy goes to the most outstanding player in college football each year?
cards.fact: The trophy’s stiff-arm pose is one of the most recognizable in sports.

cards.prompt: Which NFL team is nicknamed "America’s Team"?
cards.fact: The nickname came from the title of the team’s 1978 highlight film.

cards.prompt: Which NFL team is owned by its fans as a publicly owned nonprofit?
cards.fact: Green Bay, Wisconsin, is by far the smallest city with an NFL team.

cards.prompt: Alongside the Dallas Cowboys, which team traditionally hosts a game every Thanksgiving Day?
cards.fact: The Lions’ Thanksgiving tradition dates back to 1934.

cards.prompt: In which city is the Pro Football Hall of Fame?
cards.fact: The league that became the NFL was founded in Canton in 1920.

cards.prompt: The Rose Bowl, the oldest college bowl game, is played in which city?
cards.fact: The first Rose Bowl game was played in 1902.

cards.prompt: Which network first aired Monday Night Football in 1970?
cards.fact: The show moved to ESPN in 2006 after 36 seasons on ABC.
